originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&irq` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE true)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN false)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ true))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 6252547b8a7.c (Linux TWL4030). Dead store on 'irq' at line 12 inside irq_domain_add(). TWL4030_CORE=true, IRQ_DOMAIN=false, OF_IRQ=true. CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN is implicitly defined by CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE (lines 3-5); TWL4030_CORE=true && IRQ_DOMAIN=false is impossible in practice. When OF_IRQ=true, ops IS set to &irq_domain_simple_ops (not NULL), so the known NullDereference vbdb bug does not apply. irq is assigned from *ops but never used — simplification artifact.
